msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a elegant Spanish woman in her fifties). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia carmen-roba-complements-18.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): An elegant Spanish woman in her fifties wearing a periwinkle blue long evening gown with a flowing chiffon cape from the reference, walking at the seaside promenade of Moraira, Teulada, Alicante, Spain, with the Mediterranean behind, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia carmen-roba-complements-15.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a fuchsia satin long evening dress with long cape sleeves from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia carmen-roba-complements-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a grey oversized knit jumper with a black abstract flower appliqué and black trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia carmen-roba-complements-08.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a navy satin structured long-sleeved top with a navy midi skirt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia carmen-roba-complements-23.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a sleeveless magenta and black floral jacquard midi dress from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.

IMAGEN 4 «l2» (formato 3:4, referencia carmen-roba-complements-32.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Lifestyle fashion photo: a model wearing a navy blouse with a navy and brown check maxi skirt from the reference, candid and relaxed in a sunny street of Teulada, Spain, natural light, framed from the knees up, editorial, shallow depth of field.
